utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: How nice! Go more to the middle. Slower, slower, slower, slower. Let's accelerate. Go to the other side. Stop now, but you have to say stop. Stop. More.

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: Yes. So we test him better. Oh, my God. Okay, you can go. Like froggy, jump.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Wait, like the game? Am I supposed to 'jump' the speed limit here or dodge the puddles like an obstacle course?

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: What? No, no games! I mean the car is hopping because your foot is shaky on the clutch. Like a little frog hopping. You must stay steady.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Oh, okay. I thought you wanted me to zigzag. My bad.

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: No zigzagging! Just steady. Go to the middle of the puddle.

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: Don't let be disturbed because some of them may run across the road and you will see them. Don't worry, don't worry until you're not ready to drive. Concentrate on the bottom of the car. Get ready to stop or touch the bottom and very gently—

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: Too fast, too fast. Take hold. So we start here. Yes, I believe you can drive.
